# Run coding agent

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Run an agentic coding task with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or Aider/OpenRouter

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/agent-run@v1
  with:
    prompt: # The task for the agent. Passed to the provider verbatim.
    github-token: # Token exposed to the agent as `GH_TOKEN` so it can use the `gh` CLI.
```

## How it works

Run one agentic coding task with whichever provider the repo is configured for.

This is the provider seam for every agentic workflow in the toolkit: workflows call this
action instead of naming a vendor, so adding or swapping an agent is one file rather than
five workflows. It is the actions-toolkit descendant of agentic-toolkit's `agent-run`,
extended with an OpenRouter-backed provider.

  claude (default) → Claude Code via anthropics/claude-code-action
                     credential: claude-code-oauth-token, or anthropic-api-key
  openai           → OpenAI Codex CLI, headless (`codex exec`)
                     credential: openai-api-key
  gemini           → Google Gemini CLI, headless (`gemini --prompt`)
                     credential: gemini-api-key
  aider            → Aider against any OpenRouter model — the "bring your own model"
                     path. One key, any frontier or open-weights model, and it swaps
                     without touching the workflow.
                     credential: openrouter-api-key (or openai-api-key + base-url)

Aliases: anthropic → claude; codex / openai-codex → openai; google / google-gemini →
gemini; openrouter → aider. Empty means claude.

── Why full-auto is safe here ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Headless CI must never block on a tool-approval prompt, so every provider runs in its
unattended mode (Claude `bypassPermissions`, Codex bypass-approvals, Gemini `--yolo`,
Aider `--yes-always`). That is acceptable *only* because the boundary is the ephemeral
runner and the job's `permissions:` block — not the agent's own judgment. Give the job
the narrowest token that lets it do its work, and never run this on `pull_request_target`
with untrusted input. See docs/SECURITY.md.

── The safety net ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Claude Code drives git itself. Codex, Gemini, and Aider are backed by a deterministic
fallback: if `push-branch` is set and the agent left commits or a dirty tree behind, this
action commits, pushes, and (when `open-pr`) opens the PR. Every branch of it is
idempotent, so it is a no-op when the agent already did the work.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | **yes** | — | The task for the agent. Passed to the provider verbatim. |
| `provider` | no | `""` | claude \| openai \| gemini \| aider (aliases accepted). Empty means claude. |
| `model` | no | `""` | Explicit model override. Empty falls back to `default-model` or the CLI default. |
| `default-model` | no | `sonnet` | Fallback model tier when `model` is empty. Claude and Aider honour this. |
| `max-turns` | no | `""` | Cap on agent loop iterations. Honoured by Claude, Gemini, and Aider. |
| `claude-code-oauth-token` | no | `""` | Claude Code OAuth token (`claude setup-token`). |
| `anthropic-api-key` | no | `""` | Anthropic API key. Alternative to the OAuth token. |
| `openai-api-key` | no | `""` | OpenAI API key, for the Codex provider or an OpenAI-backed Aider. |
| `gemini-api-key` | no | `""` | Google AI Studio API key, for the Gemini provider. |
| `openrouter-api-key` | no | `""` | OpenRouter API key, for the Aider provider. |
| `github-token` | **yes** | — | Token exposed to the agent as `GH_TOKEN` so it can use the `gh` CLI. |
| `push-branch` | no | `""` | Branch to commit and push the agent's changes to. Empty disables the safety net. |
| `commit-message` | no | `chore(agent): apply agent changes` | Commit message for the safety-net commit. |
| `open-pr` | no | `false` | true to open a PR from `push-branch` when the agent did not open one. |
| `pr-title` | no | `""` | Title for the safety-net PR. |
| `pr-body` | no | `""` | Body for the safety-net PR. Include `Closes #NNN` to auto-close an issue. |
| `pr-labels` | no | `""` | Comma-separated labels to apply to the safety-net PR. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `provider` | The resolved provider that ran. |
| `model` | The resolved model, or empty when the CLI default was used. |
| `changed` | `true` if the run produced commits or pushed a branch. |
